newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somali aid worker killed in north Mogadishu.
newsitem.headline: Somali aid worker killed in north Mogadishu.

text.p: Gunmen shot dead a Somali aid worker in northern Mogadishu and wounded three other people when they opened fire on their vehicle, witnesses said on Wednesday.
They said Osman Barre Abdi, a logistics officer with the international medical aid agency Medecins sans Frontieres (Doctors Without Borders), was hit by bullets in the head and chest.
Three other Somalis, including two aid workers, were wounded. A motive for the Tuesday night attack was not known.
Most foreign aid workers pulled out of the divided Somali capital shortly before a U.N. troop withdrawal in 1995.
